📍 COMAL COUNTY, TEXAS — With Election Day approaching on Tuesday, November 3, early voting numbers show strong participation across Comal County, including Canyon Lake, New Braunfels, Bulverde, Spring Branch, and surrounding communities!

📊 COMAL COUNTY EARLY VOTING BY THE NUMBERS:

🗳️ 70,051 — TOTAL EARLY BALLOTS REPORTED

📬 3,183 — Mail-In Ballots

👥 152,424 — Registered Voters

📈 46.0% — Reported Voter Turnout

🇺🇸 ELECTION DAY IS TOMORROW!

📅 Tuesday, November 3, 2026

⏰ Polls open from 7 AM to 7 PM.

📍 Comal County voters can check official polling locations and election information through the Comal County Elections Office.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: These early voting figures reflect reporting through October 30 and are attributed to Texas Secretary of State data. They remain unofficial and may be revised as election officials reconcile ballots.

✅ Did you vote early?

👇 Let us know in the comments!

📡 Source: Texas Secretary of State election data, as reported by independent election trackers.

item.caption:
I’ve been thinking a lot about something Rev. Anna Golladay said during a sermon a little over a week ago, “Voting is one of the ways that love stands up.”

As a psychologist, I’ve always appreciated that my profession’s ethical principles emphasize justice and social responsibility. To me, that responsibility doesn’t end when I leave the classroom. Being part of a community means caring about more than just what affects us personally. It means recognizing that the decisions made by our elected officials have real consequences for our neighbors, especially those whose voices aren’t always heard. It’s what motivated me to run for public office and what continues to motivate me to stay involved post-election.

I’ve been reflecting on how voting is one of the simplest ways we can put that care into action. We may not all agree on what our communities need, but I hope we can agree that looking out for one another matters. Tomorrow is Election Day, and one of the best ways we can love our neighbors is to stand up for them when we vote. 

#electionday #election2026 #hamiltoncounty #tennessee
